body:
Merged main to resolve conflicts. The PR is stacked on #593, so I merged #593's refreshed branch first, which brings main with it. upstream/main was then already up to date.

- **`setup_plane_pick.rs`:** main's #664 row mark and its `collecting()` arm test, plus this PR's short-lines note. The PR's row layout is unchanged.
- **`setup_axis_pick.rs`:** I took main's #557 own-line picks text (document units, never a feature id), which replaces this PR's extra line that printed feature ids. Both did the same job of keeping the picks off the button row, and main's is the hand-checked wording.

Targeted gate:
- app `plane_align` 9, `points_align` 8.
- ui all suites green (lib 428).
- clippy `-D warnings` on ui lib+tests: clean.

Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check). The axis-row hunk dropped this PR's line in favour of main's, so please give it a delta look. Merge order: #593, then this one.

<!-- pr-reviewer: ddd9f8f33be0c0a668c01aa9f317a401b3acb373 -->
Delta review (merge of #555's refreshed branch since e9aae416): clean.

Only commit since the last review is a merge of the stack parent's branch (issue/555, head 9e9104cb, which itself merged main). Checked: `git diff upstream/main --stat` lists only this PR's files plus the stacked #555 files (nothing from main dropped). Two conflicts: `setup_plane_pick::row` takes main's #664 row mark (`setup_pick_rows`) and the `mine` / `collecting` armed test, and keeps this PR's "short lines" comment; `setup_axis_pick::axis_row` takes main's own-line picks text (units, never a feature id) in place of this PR's feature-id line, so the axis row still ends with Flip and the picks line is separate. The #330 feature still works: `plane_face_lay` and the plane_align additions pass on the merged tree. No safety check lost.

Tests (debug): app `plane_align` 5/5, `points_align` 9/9, `mcp_setup` 8/8; ui lib (CWD crates/ui) filters plane_face_lay, points_vertex_pick, setup_points_tests, setup_plane_tests, setup_picks_disarm, structural, setup_axis 25/25. `clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --lib` plus the touched test targets with `-D warnings`: clean.

<!-- pr-reviewer: ddd9f8f33be0c0a668c01aa9f317a401b3acb373 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (delta review)

Delta review of the merge(s) since the last reviewed head `e9aae41`; current head `ddd9f8f`. Only merge-of-main commits were added, no new own code.

**Checked**
- Merges 9e9104cb (main into #593's branch) and ddd9f8f3 (that branch into this one): main's #664 row marks (`setup_pick_rows`, `disarm_hidden`, `pick_coords`) and #593's points draft are both kept; in `setup_plane_pick.rs` the `mine/armed` logic from main stays with this PR's short-lines note; `setup_axis_pick.rs` takes main's own-line picks text; the points draft joins #664's page-shown law (`axis_pick.rs` disarm_hidden). Overlap with #593: #593's current head `9e9104c` is an ancestor of this head, so the stack is exactly current; whichever merges first, the other needs no rework (merge #593 first, then this one).
- `gh pr diff 603 --name-only` lists only this PR's own files; no snapshot PNG, CHANGELOG.md or RECOMMENDED.md edits.
- Trial merge with current origin/main (`4827fde6`): already up to date, no conflicts, GitHub reports MERGEABLE.

**Local results (merged with main)**
- camcraft-app: plane_align 5, winding_align 9, points_align 8, mcp_setup 9 passed
- camcraft-ui lib (from crates/ui, filter plane/setup/structural/points): 74 passed
- clippy: camcraft-app lib + plane_align/points_align/mcp_setup, and camcraft-ui --all-targets, -D warnings: clean

(Cannot re-run the full app --all-targets clippy: it fails on main itself, see `lathe_thread_travel.rs:83`, untouched here.)

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
